title: Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe with Chinese Twist
description: An Italian-inspired dish with a fusion of Chinese flavors. A classic spaghetti dish with a spicy kick.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the spaghetti.
Cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the diced peppers and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the Italian Cacio cheese and stir until melted.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the cheese sauce and toss to combine.
Transfer the spaghetti to a serving dish and top with Comte cheese.
Sprinkle the yeasty bread breadcrumbs on top.
